<h2>Run One sjSDM Tier Tuning Round</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Runs one explicit tier survivor or final artifact target without a nested
callr boundary.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_tuning_tier_round(
  tuning_strategy = NULL,
  tier_target_name = NULL,
  fresh_round = FALSE,
  final_round = FALSE,
  run_pipeline_function = run_pipeline,
  vec_allowed_profile_roles = base::c("main", "smoke"),
  vec_allowed_profile_statuses = "active"
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="tuning_strategy">tuning_strategy</code>, <code id="tier_target_name">tier_target_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Strategy and optional staged tier target.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fresh_round">fresh_round</code>, <code id="final_round">final_round</code></td>
<td>
<p>First- and final-round flags.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="run_pipeline_function">run_pipeline_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable pipeline runner.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vec_allowed_profile_roles">vec_allowed_profile_roles</code>, <code id="vec_allowed_profile_statuses">vec_allowed_profile_statuses</code></td>
<td>
<p>Allowed profile metadata forwarded to the runner.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisible 'NULL'.
</p>
